# Lab 24.7: Deploy Cloud IDS

## What We Are Going to Do
Deploy a Cloud IDS endpoint, mirror traffic to it, send a test attack and read the threat alert.

## Steps

1. **Know the cost.** A Cloud IDS endpoint is billed per hour and takes about 15 to 20 minutes to create. Delete it right after the lab.

2. **Set up private services access.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable ids.googleapis.com servicenetworking.googleapis.com
gcloud compute addresses create ids-range --global --purpose=VPC_PEERING \
  --prefix-length=24 --network=default
gcloud services vpc-peerings connect --service=servicenetworking.googleapis.com \
  --ranges=ids-range --network=default</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create the IDS endpoint.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud ids endpoints create lab-ids --network=default --zone=us-central1-a \
  --severity=INFORMATIONAL
gcloud ids endpoints describe lab-ids --zone=us-central1-a --format="value(endpointForwardingRule)"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Create a server and a client, then mirror the server's traffic.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create ids-server ids-client --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro
gcloud compute ssh ids-server --zone=us-central1-a --command="sudo apt-get update &amp;&amp; sudo apt-get -y install apache2"

gcloud compute packet-mirrorings create ids-mirror --region=us-central1 \
  --network=default --mirrored-instances=projects/$PROJECT_ID/zones/us-central1-a/instances/ids-server \
  --collector-ilb=FORWARDING_RULE_FROM_STEP_3</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Send test attack patterns** from the client.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute ssh ids-client --zone=us-central1-a --command="\
curl -s -m5 'http://SERVER_INTERNAL_IP/cgi-bin/../../../..//bin/cat%20/etc/passwd'; \
curl -s -m5 'http://SERVER_INTERNAL_IP/?item=../../../../WINNT/win.ini'"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **See the threats.** Go to **Network Security → Cloud IDS → Threats**. You see the attacks with severity and threat name. The traffic itself was not blocked.

7. **Clean up the paid parts.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute packet-mirrorings delete ids-mirror --region=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud ids endpoints delete lab-ids --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud compute instances delete ids-server ids-client --zone=us-central1-a --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Detection | Threats listed in Cloud IDS |
| Blocking | None, Cloud IDS only detects |
| Traffic source | Packet Mirroring |
| Need blocking? | Use Cloud NGFW Enterprise |
